summary: Researched the evening before (Thu 19 Nov); lineups are not out, so this is a draft until the morning check and the final check. Friday has the top football leagues back after the international break, DEL, KHL and Liiga hockey, ATP Finals tennis and esports; basketball is no longer researched (the owner's permanent rule). Eight games were researched; three are medium. Medium: Bayern v Köln (DraftKings about 92% for Bayern; the only leg kept is Bayern over 2.5 team goals, since a 1-0 or 2-1 is the named risk), Athletic v Espanyol (DraftKings and Elo agree on a clear home favourite; legs kept: under 3.5 goals, Espanyol under 1.5 goals; a draw is the main risk), Troyes v Le Havre (a relegation six-pointer; Troyes or draw backed by DraftKings and ClubElo; legs kept: under 3.5, Le Havre +1.5, Troyes under 2.5). Low: Eisbären Berlin v Ingolstadt and JYP v HIFK (no second price), Avangard v Barys (goalies unknown, Barys won 3 of the last 5). Excluded: Shanghai v CSKA (Shanghai play their home games in St Petersburg: neutral venue). Morning check (Fri): nothing new overnight. Troyes stay medium (Polymarket unchanged, DraftKings steady at 2.20 so the earlier drift stopped); Athletic stay medium (Espanyol's Edu Expósito reportedly did not travel; DraftKings unchanged). Final check (18:20-18:35 UTC): Troyes drop to low (their price fell 3.7% since first listing and DraftKings lengthened again to 2.25, with no news to explain it; official XIs not yet out). Athletic stay medium (price up; Espanyol's Expósito probably out; the Espanyol under 1.5 view is cut to 0.75 because both markets moved toward goals). Bayern re-checked at 18:30 UTC: price unchanged, DraftKings total 4.5 (over -125); predicted XI has Kane, Olise and Karl; the over 2.5 team goals view is trimmed to 0.72.

checks.team_news: Afternoon update (18:30 UTC): official XI NOT yet available (ESPN rosters empty; kicker/bundesliga pages returned were old matchdays). Predicted Bayern XI (come-on-fc, Spox, comunio): Urbig; Stanisic, Tah, Upamecano, Laimer; Pavlovic, Kimmich; Brown, Olise, Karl; Kane. Kane, Olise and Karl are expected to start; Musiala is expected to be a substitute (comunio); Diaz is out (muscle tear). Neuer, Davies, Gnabry and Saibari are also out. Koln out: Hubers, van den Berg and per Hard Tackle Rondic, Skhiri and Dallinga; Ache is a doubt. Koln are predicted in a 3-5-2 or 3-4-2-1 with Schwabe in goal and Bulter and El Mala up front. Kompany is back on the touchline. The goalkeeper (Urbig, likely) is unconfirmed.
checks.lineups: Unconfirmed. Previews agree on the outfield and attack above (Kane up front, Olise and Karl behind him). I could not check the FC Bayern X account or Bild. The official XI was not out at 18:30 UTC.
checks.rotation: Bayern had a full-rest week and no midweek game. No rotation is reported. Koln lost 2-1 to Leverkusen before the break.
checks.motivation: Bayern top the table on 21 points, level with Dortmund, so they need the win. Koln are 15th and two points clear of the relegation zone. Not a hard-exclusion case.
checks.form: Bayern are unbeaten in the league (6W 3D), have scored in 12 straight games, and have scored 20 goals in 4 home league games. Koln are winless in 4 league games and have 1 point from 4 away games.
checks.h2h: Koln have lost 22 of their last 24 meetings with Bayern. The last three were 5-1, 3-1 and 4-1, each a Bayern win by 2 or more with Koln scoring once.
checks.odds: This afternoon: DraftKings via ESPN is Bayern -1600, draw +1000 (was +1100), Koln +1900 (was +1800); total 4.5, over -125 (was -120); spread Bayern -2.5. Live Polymarket home 0.9158 / draw 0.0567 / away 0.0275, against 0.9152 / 0.0555 / 0.0293 at first listing, so the favourite has not moved against us. The 24h move on the home side is -1.1% (0.915 to 0.905). tt_home_2.5_over is 0.76 live (0.77 first), tt_home_3.5_over 0.57. No Stake or Rainbet prices seen.
checks.models: Not fetched. The ClubElo API returned 503 in the morning. Previews predict 4-1, 3-1 and 4-0, which are not bookmaker-free ratings.
checks.venue_weather: Allianz Arena, a normal home venue, 19:30 UTC. No weather or pitch problem found, but I did not check a forecast.

games.reason: A heavy favourite with the book and Polymarket agreeing, and the price has not moved against Bayern. Confidence stays medium because the official XI was not out when checked, so Kane's start and the attack are only predicted. The view on Bayern over 2.5 team goals is kept at a lowered 0.72: a likely attack of Kane, Olise and Karl, 20 goals in 4 home games, and DK's total of 4.5. The slightly dearer over price (-125) and the unconfirmed XI are why I trim it below the market's 0.76.
games.main_risk: A cagey 1-0 or 2-1 win, or a draw. The attack is unconfirmed (Diaz out, Musiala likely only a substitute, Kane scoreless in four games), and Koln have scored once in each of the last three meetings, so a 2-1 would fail the over 2.5 team goals leg. If the XI shows Kane out, drop the view.

checks.team_news: Final check (Fri 20 Nov, ~18:30 UTC). Official squad lists and XIs NOT found yet: the ESPN summary (event 401882805) returned empty rosters and no formations, and searches turned up no official convocatoria or XI. Edu Exposito remains unconfirmed. This afternoon's search snippets (Comuniate) say he again trained apart with slight muscle discomfort, which fits this morning's TV3/Futbolfantasy report that he was not travelling. So he is probably out but not official. Espanyol's attack, expected 3-5-2: Roberto Fernandez with Pere Milla up front, Javi Hernandez or Pol Lozano in midfield; Kike Garcia and Calatrava out. Athletic absences unchanged (Vivian, Guruzeta, Sannadi, Egiluz out; Paredes back in training). No new late injury or suspension news found.

Williams. Expected Espanyol 3-5-2: Fortuno; El Hilali, Cabrera, Hartman; Santiago, Dolan, Lozano, J. Hernandez (Exposito doubtful), Milla; Roberto Fernandez plus a partner.
checks.rotation: No rotation expected for either side; both had a full break.
checks.motivation: Unchanged: Athletic 7th, Espanyol 13th, two points above the drop zone.
checks.form: Unchanged: Athletic 4W-4D-3L; Espanyol two straight clean sheets in a 3-5-2.
checks.h2h: Not researched in depth; the draw is the main failure for Athletic.
checks.odds: Polymarket live 0.6634 / 0.2031 / 0.1334 vs first listing 0.6534 / 0.2131 / 0.1335: Athletic +1.0 pt, draw -1.0 pt, no drift against the favourite. Espanyol under 1.5 goals fell from 0.795 at listing to 0.775 live (-2 pts). Over 2.5 rose 0.535 to 0.585, Espanyol over 0.5 rose 0.555 to 0.59 and Under 3.5 fell 0.695 to 0.645. The market now expects more goals and a little more Espanyol scoring than this morning. DraftKings via ESPN, fetched now: Athletic moneyline about -210 (was -205/-210 earlier), total 2.5 over -155 / under +125 (this morning -125 / +100, so it also moved toward goals). Only the over/under, moneyline and spread lines came through; the draw price was not parsed. Athletic win prob. de-vigged is roughly 0.65, in line with Polymarket.

checks.venue_weather: San Mames, 20:00 UTC kick-off; no pitch or weather problem reported.

games.reason: Athletic is still a clear home favourite: the price has not moved against it (up 1 pt since listing), and DraftKings agrees. Confidence is medium and not high because the squad lists and XIs are unconfirmed and Exposito's status is still open. The Espanyol under 1.5 view is kept but cut to 0.75: the leg fell 2 pts since listing and both Polymarket and DraftKings moved toward more goals this afternoon. The Under 3.5 view is dropped because it no longer clears the bar.
games.main_risk: A draw or an Espanyol upset. For the Espanyol under 1.5 leg, the risk is Espanyol scoring twice on the counter or from set pieces against Athletic's makeshift back line, and the market drift toward goals. Late XI news could change this, especially if Exposito starts.

checks.team_news: Final check (Fri 20 Nov, about 18:30 UTC): no club, press or injury news found for either side that explains the late move. Morning list still stands, unconfirmed: Troyes - Diaz suspended (return est. 20 Nov), Ouzenadji out; Le Havre - Pembele doubtful, Mambimbi and Jelert absent, Mpasi back. NEW: a Sportsmole probable XI now lists Diaz in the Troyes XI, so his availability is unresolved. Nothing found that hurts Le Havre either. No press conference found.

Le Havre Bodart; Sasso, Koffi, Touba; Ouziad, Ebonog, Mwanga, Richardson; Fofana, Samatta; Maja. Unconfirmed.

checks.motivation: Unchanged: relegation six-pointer, Troyes 17th (8 pts), Le Havre 18th (2 pts). Le Havre desperate under a new coach.
checks.form: Unchanged: Troyes L-L-D-W-L, Le Havre five straight league losses; Ismael about 8 days in charge, first away game. New this afternoon: Sportsmole's preview now tips a Le Havre win (0-1), a change from its earlier model view.
checks.h2h: Unchanged: 8 meetings, Troyes 4 wins, Le Havre 3, 1 draw; last was Ligue 2, May 2021. Not informative.
checks.odds: Polymarket LIVE 0.4267 / 0.2766 / 0.2967 vs first listing 0.4433 / 0.2833 / 0.2733: Troyes down 3.7% relative (1.7 pts), Le Havre up 8.6% relative. Past the 3% line. Troyes draw-no-bet / home_draw live 0.7033 vs 0.7266 first. DraftKings (ESPN, fetched about 18:21 UTC): Troyes 2.25 (+125) / draw 3.35 / Le Havre 3.25 (+225), de-vigged 0.423 / 0.284 / 0.293, vs this morning 2.20 / 3.45 / 3.30 and opening 2.05: Troyes has lengthened again (2.20 to 2.25) and draw/away shortened; 24h move on home -4.5% (0.445 to 0.425). So the independent book is drifting the same way as Polymarket. No news found to explain the fall in either market (no injury, no confirmed XI). Under the rule: unexplained fall of 3% or more since p_first = low.

games.reason: Confidence low, no exceptions rule: Troyes' price is down 3.7% since first listing (0.4433 to 0.4267) and DraftKings has lengthened the same way (2.20 to 2.25 since this morning, from 2.05 opening) while Le Havre shortened, and I found no news that explains it. Official XIs were not available at check time, and Diaz's suspension is unresolved (a probable XI includes him). Troyes DNB is now 0.70 on the market (was 0.73), and the only losing outcome is a Le Havre win, which the market now prices at 29.7%. Not excluded as no key player is confirmed out, but treat as low-confidence and consider dropping from the slip.
games.main_risk: A Le Havre win (new-coach first away game, desperate side, Maja scoring) is the only way Troyes DNB loses, and both Polymarket and DraftKings are moving toward it with no explanation. Troyes form is 1 win in 5. Open: official XIs and Diaz suspension.

checks.team_news: No injury list for either side found for 20 Nov. berlinecho (preview of the 18 Nov CHL return leg) mentions no injuries. Berliner Kurier reported before the 30 Oct game that Berlin had only four natural defenders and a penalty for Jonas Müller; this is old and unnamed, so current status is unverified. Nothing found on Ingolstadt's injuries.

So Fri 20 Nov is two days after a midweek home game, no back-to-back, no travel. Ingolstadt: played at Mannheim Sun 15 Nov (score not found); anything after that was not found. Berlin may rest players ahead of the CHL quarter-final, which is unverified.

Ingolstadt's table position is unknown. Both are in the regular season with nothing decided, so no hard rule applies. I could not confirm the standings after 15 Nov.

The full last 10 with goals was not found. Ingolstadt: 13 Nov won 4:1 vs Straubing (three goals in the third period, leagues derby); 15 Nov at Mannheim (result not found). Berlin goal difference +25 after 15 games.

Ingolstadt coach Mark French; Berlin coach Eric Dubois was Ingolstadt assistant last season. No further 2026/27 meetings found (Ingolstadt away already played).
checks.odds: No second price found. The candidates file has no data.odds (DraftKings not available). Searches for German odds previews (wettbasis etc.) returned only older seasons. Polymarket: Berlin 0.685, Ingolstadt 0.315; move_24h 0.685 to 0.685 (0% change, p_first 0.685). Polymarket volume about 21 dollars and liquidity about 1265 dollars, so the market is thin and unconfirmed. Without an independent price, the rating cannot be above low.
checks.models: No bookmaker-free rating found. Only table data: Berlin first with +25 goal difference after 15 games, 33 points. Berlin has since lost two league games (13 and 15 Nov, both in the standings).
checks.venue_weather: Uber Arena, Berlin, home game (sportschau 20.11.2026 19:30 local = 18:30 UTC; berlinecho also states Uber Arena for the 15 Nov home game). Indoor, no weather issue. Not a neutral or unusual venue.

games.reason: Fixture verified as a regular DEL home game for league leader Berlin (20 Nov, 19:30 local) with no hard exclusion found. Rated low because there is no independent second price, the Polymarket market is very thin (about 21 dollars volume), Berlin's starting goalie is unclear (LaFontaine came on for Neffin on 15 Nov), and Berlin has lost its last two league games (3:4 SO at Wolfsburg, 2:4 vs Schwenningen) after a midweek CHL game. p is cut from the market by 3.5 points because of this.
games.main_risk: Berlin's recent slump (two league losses, three straight per berlinecho) and an uncertain goalie, combined with fatigue from the Wednesday CHL game and possible rotation before the CHL quarter-final, against an Ingolstadt side that scored 3 goals in the 30 Oct game and won 4:1 on 13 Nov. Also an OT/shootout coin flip. No second price to confirm 68.5%.

games.reason: Hard rule: unusual/neutral venue. Shanghai Dragons play all 2026/27 'home' games at SKA Arena in St Petersburg, not in Shanghai (club announcement via Sportbox; KHL president says a move to China is only planned for 2027/28). This game is listed at SKA-Arena, St Petersburg, Fri 20 Nov 2026, 19:30 local (16:30 UTC) per peterburg2.ru. It is a home-in-name game with no Shanghai crowd, in the arena shared with SKA, so I treat it as a neutral venue. Fixture, date and teams otherwise verified. Not checked because of the exclusion: goalies, injuries, standings and Fonbet/Winline prices. Polymarket 24h move was small (CSKA 0.675 to 0.685).
games.main_risk: Neutral-style venue: the Polymarket home/away labels may not reflect a real home edge, and Shanghai's 'home' crowd is absent. The market price is unreliable for this setup.

checks.team_news: Sportmail.ru match page (read tonight) says Avangard forward Cedric Paquette was hospitalized after the 18 Nov game against Admiral, having played under 6 minutes. No current status is given, and my follow-up searches found no confirmation or return date. The same page says Barys goalie Hunter Shepard terminated his contract on 17 Nov, and Dmitry Nikolaev arrived from Traktor by trade on 12 Nov. Older Avangard coverage (sport24, undated) has coach Boucher saying the club was in survival mode with 11 injured, 9 of them key players. I could not date it to this season, so it is not weighted. I could not obtain a full injury list for either side.
checks.lineups: UNCONFIRMED. No expected starting goalie was found for either side; the sportmail lineups section is empty and no preview names goalies. Nikita Serebryakov appears in the protocol list of the 18 Nov Avangard-Admiral game, but the page did not label which team he played for. Barys' goalie picture is unsettled after the Shepard exit and the Nikolaev trade. This is the key missing fact.
checks.rotation: Avangard played at home on Wed 18 Nov and beat Admiral 3:1 (goals Livo, Sharipzyanov, Ponomarev; sportmail.ru match 8129373). Friday is therefore a home game on 1 day of rest with no travel. Before that, Avangard won 5:1 at Neftekhimik on 14 Nov, won 4:3 in overtime at Metallurg Mg on 12 Nov, lost 0:4 to Dinamo Minsk on 10 Nov, and won 4:3 in overtime against Sibir on 7 Nov. Barys played at Salavat Yulaev on 18 Nov and lost (sources conflict on the score, 3:5 or 3:4), so they travel from Ufa to Omsk after one day of rest. Astana-Omsk is a short KHL trip, but it still means a back-to-back-style schedule.
checks.motivation: Standings before this game were NOT verified. The only table I could open (sportmail, season 2025-26) is last season's. A sport-express item dated 14 Nov (fetched through sportmail) says Avangard was third in the East on 30 points and Neftekhimik second on 31. The match page also shows inconsistent season stats (26 games, 39 points for Avangard; 27 games, 41 points for Barys), so I cannot rely on it. It is mid-November regular season, so neither side has anything clinched. The hard 'favourite has nothing left' rule does not apply.
checks.form: Avangard has won 4 of its last 5: W 3:1 vs Admiral, W 5:1 at Neftekhimik, W 4:3 OT at Metallurg, L 0:4 vs Dinamo Minsk, W 4:3 OT vs Sibir. Two of those wins came in overtime. Barys, from news items on the match page: W 4:2 vs Admiral (12 Nov), W 5:4 vs Metallurg (15 Nov), L vs Salavat Yulaev (18 Nov), L 0:2 at Amur (8 Nov). Barys scores freely and concedes freely (88 GF / 77 GA per the match page). I could not check goal differential or xG.
checks.h2h: Last five meetings per sportmail, newest first: Barys 5:1 (10 Oct 2026), Barys 4:2 (30 Dec 2025), Avangard 5:2 (23 Nov 2025), Avangard 4:3 (29 Oct 2025), Barys 6:2 (16 Oct 2025). Barys won 3 of 5, including the most recent game, so the 0.67 favourite price runs against the recent head-to-head.
checks.odds: Fonbet, Winline and Paribet (identical, via sportmail.ru match 8129381) price the regulation-time 1X2 at Avangard 1.70 / draw 4.30 / Barys 4.30. De-vigged (overround 5.4%) that is about 55.8% / 22.1% / 22.1%. Splitting the draw by strength gives roughly 0.67-0.69 Avangard including OT/SO, which agrees with Polymarket 0.67 / 0.33 (best bid 0.66, ask 0.68). Polymarket 24h move is flat (0.67 to 0.67). Polymarket liquidity is only about 1,858 and no event volume figure is listed (the khl-2026 series shows about 19.1k 24h volume), so the market is thin. The bookmaker 1X2 is listed on the page but I did not see a dated timestamp for it. No DraftKings/ESPN price was in the candidates data.
checks.models: No bookmaker-free rating was available (candidates data has no rating field for KHL). Rough indicators only: Avangard's recent goals 3:1, 5:1, 4:3 OT, 0:4, 4:3 OT. Barys' 88 GF / 77 GA is unreliable given the inconsistent page stats. No xG or points-percentage source was checked, so this check is effectively empty.
checks.venue_weather: Home game at G-Drive Arena, Omsk, Fri 20 Nov, 16:30 local (13:30 UTC), indoor. Fixture verified on sportmail.ru (KHL regular season, week 12). Regular venue, no weather or pitch issue.

games.reason: No hard exclusion applies. The fixture is verified, there is no coaching change found, it is not a derby, and the venue is normal. The favourite is not clinched and the Polymarket price has not moved. A bookmaker 1X2 (Fonbet/Winline 1.70/4.30/4.30) de-vigs to roughly the same 0.67-0.69 with OT, so the price is corroborated. Confidence is still low because the key fact for hockey, the starting goalie for both teams, is missing; Barys' goalie room is in flux and Avangard's goalie was not confirmed. Standings could not be verified. Paquette's hospitalization is unresolved. Barys won the last head-to-head 5:1 and 3 of the last 5. The market is thin (liquidity around 1.9k). I trimmed p slightly below the market.
games.main_risk: An unconfirmed or backup goalie for Avangard, plus a lineup thinned by injuries (Paquette hospitalized after Wednesday, other injuries unverified), against a high-scoring Barys side that won the last meeting 5:1 and took 3 of the last 5. Avangard is also on 1 day of rest after Wednesday, though Barys is too after playing Salavat Yulaev on 18 Nov. Several recent Avangard wins needed overtime. The thin Polymarket market adds price noise.

checks.odds: NO second price found. I searched Finnish odds sites (vedonlyonti.com, rahapelisanomat, ristikaksi) and found only season outright prices (JYP 9.00 and HIFK 14-25 for the title) and no moneyline for this game; the liiga.fi feed has an empty gamblingEvent, so no Veikkaus price; no data.odds in the candidates file. games.reason: Fixture verified (liiga.fi API id 2701466, JYP home vs HIFK, 2026-11-20 16:30 UTC; men's Liiga regular season). No hard exclusion: the HIFK coach change was 29 days ago (soft), no rotation confirmed, no derby, nothing decided. JYP is the better side on points per game and goal difference and is at home on 2 days rest, but I could not obtain any independent price and the Polymarket market has about $3.64 of volume, so the rule that a hockey game needs a second price within 5 points to be medium cannot be met. Goalies for both sides are unconfirmed. p is set slightly below the market to reflect hockey variance and the thin price.
games.main_risk: JYP wins in regulation or OT is only about 60%: the likely failure is a one-goal or overtime game where HIFK's Alnefelt steals it, after JYP's 3-2 OT game on Wednesday; JYP has also lost 4-6 at Tappara and 4-5 OT vs Kärpät this season. Unconfirmed goalies for both teams and a HIFK side that has gone 5-2 under its new coach. No second price, and thin Polymarket volume.
